description: Figure 16c illustrates the relationship between confidence and accuracy for the MMLU Pro dataset across different iterations. The x-axis is labeled “Initial Confidence” and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1, with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy” and also has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 1, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. Three lines are plotted: a green dashed line representing “Initial Accuracy,” a blue solid line representing “Accuracy,” and a red solid line representing “Final Accuracy.” The “Initial Accuracy” line starts at approximately 0.28 and ends at approximately 0.31, exhibiting a relatively steady trend with minor fluctuations. The “Accuracy” line begins at approximately 0.32 and ends at approximately 0.34, also showing a relatively steady trend with minor fluctuations. The “Final Accuracy” line starts at approximately 0.65 and declines to approximately 0.60, with a peak at x=0.25 where it reaches approximately 0.68.
